ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: An Introduction to Fourier Analysis and Wavelets. The course will provide a rigorous treatment of Fourier theory on the unit circle, the real line, and on finite Abelian groups, with applications to the study of wavelets. The main topics will include: (i) Fourier series and summability; (ii) The discrete Fourier and Haar transforms; (iii) The Fourier transform, Schwartz spaces, Fourier inversion, Plancherel?s theorem, distributions. (iv) Wavelet and multiresolution analysis. This course should be of interest to students in mathematics, physics, and engineering. Prerequisites: Math 416 and either Math 424 or Math 447.
